findings.message: An audio block breaks a rule that A/52 7.10.2 lists among the errors a decoder may check for: rematstr is 0 in block 0 (check 5). First in the frame at 0x0 (6 times).

An audio block holds what A/52 does not allow: chbwcod is above 60 (check 11). Decoders cannot decode the rest of such a frame, and its remaining audio blocks are not read. First in the frame at 0x900 (3 times).
